quotes.text: In politics, stupidity is not a handicap.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Death is nothing, but to live defeated and inglorious is to die daily.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: History is written by the winners.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of fools.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: A leader is a dealer in hope.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: In war, there is but one favorable moment; the great art is to seize it.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Victory belongs to the most persevering.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: With audacity one can undertake anything, but not do everything.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: A throne is only a bench covered with velvet.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Power is my mistress. I have worked too hard at her conquest to allow anyone to take her away from me.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: I used to say of Napoleon that his presence on the field made the difference of forty thousand men.
quotes.author: Arthur Wellesley

quotes.text: His life was the march of a demigod, from battle to battle and from victory to victory; One could say about him that he was in a perpetual enlightenment.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: He was the God of War.
quotes.author: Theodoros Kolokotronis

quotes.text: To fall from Bonaparte and the Empire into what followed them is to fall from reality into nothingness.
quotes.author: François-René de Chateaubriand

quotes.text: An Enemy and Disturber of the tranquility of the World, he has incurred public vengeance.
quotes.author: Declaration of the Congress of Vienna

quotes.text: I am more afraid of an army of 100 sheep led by a lion than an army of 100 lions led by a sheep
quotes.author: Talleyrand
